data.name: Portland, Maine Highlights
data.headline: For all ages! • 9 Hours
data.description:
# Are you ready for a Maine adventure? 

## Duration 
9 Hours

## About
Available in English, Spanish and Turkish.

Chauffeured driving and walking included.

Portland, Maine is a wonderful combination of rich and unexpected history, excellent food and stunning views. Experience the beauty and wonder of Portland in this one-day tour. Depending on the clients' preference, we will also visit the towns of Ogunquit and Kennebunkport. 

Food lovers will delight in the various eateries offering a wide range of local and international cuisines. Of course, fresh seafood is always a staple.  Lobster, anyone? Portland has the biggest lobster industry in America. In the historic Old Port district, the quaint cobblestone streets and fishing piers remind you of the past.

If you love art and culture, the Arts District in downtown Portland is the place to visit. The Portland Museum of Art showcases the works of American and European masters. The many small art galleries in the district house collections of paintings, sculptures, glass art, and jewelry. 

Stroll along the Eastern Promenade, a 68-acre outdoor space near the harbor. Relax here while enjoying the spectacular vistas and ocean air. Portland Head Light, the oldest lighthouse in the state, is situated in Fort Williams Park.

Portland, Maine offers year-round sightseeing for tourists of any age.
